Subject: Request: CloudTransit processor authorization + temporary transit waiver

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing to run a two-week pilot with CloudTransit (our telemetry relay) that will require them to pull a subset of anonymized telemetry for routing optimization. Our procurement and security teams asked me to confirm whether Redwood can authorize CloudTransit as a downstream processor under our DPA and whether we can grant a short-term transit waiver (they'll temporarily brokering logs through EU ingress for routing tests).

What we need from Redwood:
- Formal authorization or a template statement naming CloudTransit as an approved processor for the pilot.
- Any standard limited-scope addendum you require (we can sign).
- Confirmation of controls (encryption in transit at TLS1.2+, no retained PII, access logs).
- ETA on approvals — procurement needs this by end of week to hit pilot start.

Attaching the CloudTransit onboarding form they provided (we'll forward their contact if useful).

Thanks,
Julia Fong
Head of IT Operations | Acme Health

Hi Julia — thanks for the details.

I've drafted a limited-scope processor authorization addendum and a short checklist that covers:
- Purpose & limited data types (aggregated telemetry, no PII)
- Transit restrictions and mitigations (TLS1.2+, mTLS where available, ephemeral retention max 72 hours)
- Right to audit and access logs (redacted tenant IDs allowed for debugging)
- Subprocessor chaining (CloudTransit may not further subcontract without prior written notice)

Please see the attached authorization_form.pdf — it includes two signature blocks (Acme + CloudTransit) and a clause for a temporary transit waiver (if Acme signs, Redwood will implement a policy to route pilot traffic via the specified transit path for up to 30 days).

A couple of notes/asks from our side:
- Lauren: confirm we can accept the proposed 72-hour ephemeral retention for the pilot or request a shorter window.
- Julia: please confirm CloudTransit's technical contact + Docusign recipient. Also confirm there will be no raw PII fields included in the export; hashed tenant IDs are OK.

If everything checks out, we can issue a signed copy by COB Friday.

—Marissa Cole
